checks: Zero/one/two attendees: every class/booking/return/audit write and quota rollback has no intermediate events; atomic exact return and capacity0; immutable original grants, after-start exact replay and changed-intent conflict; own readback proves return with original expiry, no body/contact receipt duplication.
Uniquely decoded legacy debit receives a newly linked return; original legacy debit/grant history is untouched.
Every required scoped table read rejection fails closed with no cancellation, return, receipt or partial events.

Missing/foreign actor, attendee, grant, debit or booking; unlinked/shared consumption; voucher, occupancy and duplicate preferences; foreign/duplicate query rows reject the whole operation. No inferred entitlement.
Receipt replay after start still requires fresh owned actor/session/attendee/booking/grant; deleted or reassigned rows cannot acknowledge success or create another return.
A frozen original lot remains frozen with unchanged original rows and zero usable balance; cancellation does not extend or thaw the purchase.
Nine non-admin roles and a non-mock provider are rejected before mutation; no production adapter calls.
Actual held SHA digest proves input snapshot plus original live actor callback, AbortSignal and now callback survive caller replacement for both review and command.
Actor deletion, staged abort and fresh clock crossing class start inside the actual atomic callback roll back before commit.
Lost acknowledgement replays exactly once after start; postcommit actor loss reports unconfirmed while preserving the committed cancellation (no false rollback claim).
Concurrent identical commands yield one cancellation/receipt/linked return.
Own readback requires canonical linked original terms, rejects foreign booking and uses no staff audit readership; generic/malformed returns are unverified.
Cancelled occurrence cannot offer a waitlist place and retains existing waitlist history; normal claim booking already rejects cancelled occurrence.
Held real digest actor-inactivation at end of review, command and own readback rejects stale success; staged and postcommit cases preserve honest commit semantics.
Exact current legacy customer closure rejects studio reason before any write, preventing unlinked immortal/duplicate returns; default customer deadline policy stays unchanged.
stage: Domain regressions; rendered/build gates recorded separately.
